```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library('rlang')
library('ggplot2')
library('plyr')
library('plyr')
library('knitr')
```

## EV Results

```{r}
file= "GLOBAL/EV/mergedEV.csv"
dt <- read.csv(file, sep = ",", header=TRUE ) 

colnames(dt) <- c("group", "precision", "recall", "f1score", "support", "model", "data", "scale", "algorithm") #, "AUC_VAL"
dt$cat<-NA
dt$cat[dt$algorithm=="CMMS"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$algorithm=="G_H"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$algorithm=="HSV"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$algorithm=="RGB"] <- "COLOR"
dt$cat[dt$algorithm=="GLCM"] <- "TEXTURE"
dt$cat[dt$algorithm=="HRLK"] <- "TEXTURE"
dt$cat[dt$algorithm=="LBP"] <- "TEXTURE"
dt$cat <- as.factor(dt$cat)
dt$group <- as.factor(dt$group)
summary(dt)
```


```{r}
dt2<-dt[dt$group=='macro avg', ]
head(dt2)
```


```{r}
dtt.stats<-ddply(dt2, c("data", "algorithm", "cat", "model", "scale"), summarise, #
                 nobs = length(scale), 
                 scales = length(unique(scale )),
                 f1 = round(mean(f1score, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
                 )
head(dtt.stats, 40)
```

```{r f1, echo=FALSE, dpi=350, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 6}
d<- dtt.stats[dtt.stats$data=="C01" & dtt.stats$model=="MLP", ]
d
```

```{r}
dt_G<-ddply(dt2, c("data", "algorithm", "cat", "scale"), summarise, #
                 nobs = length(scale), 
                 scales = length(unique(scale )),
                 f1 = round(mean(f1score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                f1.sd = round(sd(f1score, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
                 )
summary(dt_G)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, dpi=300, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
plot1 <- ggplot(dt_G[dt_G$cat=="COLOR",], aes(x=as.factor(scale), y=f1, group=algorithm, fill=algorithm)) +
         geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(width=0.9)) + 
        #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=f1 - sd, ymax=f1 + sd), 
         #              width=0.2, position=position_dodge(width=0.9))
      #geom_errorbar( aes(x=as.factor(scale), ymin=(f1-f1.sd), ymax=(f1+f1.sd)), width=0.4, colour="orange", alpha=0.9, size=1.3)+
   theme_bw() +facet_wrap(vars(data), ncol = 4)+ 
   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), 
           axis.line = element_line(size=1, colour = "black"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", size=0),
           panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#d3d3d3"),
           panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
           panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
           plot.title = element_text(size = 14,  face = "bold"), #family = "Garamond",
           text=element_text(), #family="Garamond"
           axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, colour="black", size = 9),
           axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size = 9)) 
plot1
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, dpi=300, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
# With a line graph
pd <- position_dodge(.3)
#ggplot(dt_G[dt_G$cat=="COLOR" & dt_G$algorithm=="G_H",], aes(x = as.factor(scale), y = f1, fill=data, group=data)) +
ggplot(dt_G[dt_G$cat=="COLOR", ], aes(x =  as.factor(scale), y = f1, color = data, group = data)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = f1 - f1.sd, ymax = f1 + f1.sd), width = .2, size = 0.25, colour = "gray", position = pd
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(shape=data), position = pd) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=data), position = pd, size = 3)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(0, 1, 8, 11, 15, 16, 17,  6))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0.1, 1)) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+
  theme_bw() +facet_wrap(vars(algorithm), ncol = 2)+ 
   theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), 
           axis.line = element_line(size=1, colour = "black"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", size=0),
           panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#d3d3d3"),
           panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
           panel.border = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
           plot.title = element_text(size = 14,  face = "bold"), #family = "Garamond",
           text=element_text(), #family="Garamond"
           axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, colour="black", size = 9),
           axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black", size = 9)
         ) +
  labs(x = "Scale", y = "F1-score", subtitle='Color global features')
```
